snippet.title: HUSHARU 2 Teaser [4K] R Narayana Murthy, Harsha Konuganti, Rahul Ramakrishna,Ashok Galla, Sunny M.R.
snippet.description:
Watch! #Husharu2 Official Teaser. Get ready for double the fun and double the madness! The cult gang from the 2018 Telugu Blockbuster #Husharu are now stepping into a crazy new world. 

The boys who made you fall in love with 
#Undiporaadhey and vibe to #Pichaak are bringing the ultimate non-stop ride back to 
Tollywood!

Catch the madness in theatres soon! 

Movie Details:  
Movie Name: Husharu 2  
Written & Directed by: Sree Harsha Konuganti  
Production Houses: Caveman Stories, HK Films, Kaliyuga Vaaradha Creations  
Producers: Rahul Varma, K. Veena Rani, K. Hanumanth Raju  
Co-Producer: Komatireddy Sharan Reddy  
Associate Producer: Devanpelly Tirupati 
Cast: Peoples Star R Narayana Murthy, Rahul Ramakrishna, Ashok Galla, Ravi Anthony, 
Dinesh Tej, Sasidhar Kocharlakota, Vidhi Yadhav, Abhignya Vuthuluru, Bhagwan Tiwari, Jatin 
Goswami, Rajai Rowan 

Crew:  
Director of Photography (DOP): G. Srinivas Reddy  
Music Director: Sunny M.R.  
Additional Music: Ram Miryala  
Editor: Vijay Vardhan Kavuri  
Art Director: Srikanth Ramisetty  
Executive Producer: Jakkula Venkatesh Vadav  
Costume Designer: Azad Varma  
PRO: Naidu - Phani (Beyond Media) 
Marketing: Ticket Factory 
Events: Youwe Media

snippet.description:
Rang Hai Rang Hai Mangal Rang hai, Prem Ke Rangon Ka Sangam! 🕉️

Presenting the Song "Mangal Rang (Hindi)" from from "Namit Malhotra’s Ramayana".

Namit Malhotra's "Ramayana"
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari

In Cinemas Worldwide, Diwali 2026.

Namit Malhotra’s "Ramayana"
Our Truth. Our History.

Starring: 
Ranbir Kapoor as Rama 
Yash as Ravana 
Sai Pallavi as Sita 
Ravie Dubey as Lakshman 
Sunny Deol as Hanuman

Music by Hans Zimmer & A.R. Rahman
Lyrics by Kumar Vishwas

snippet.title: Dune: Part Three | Final Trailer
snippet.description:
Do not fear the end. Dune: Part Three only in theaters and IMAX December 18. Tickets on sale now around the world. http://fandan.co/DunePartThree #DuneMovie #FilmedForIMAX 

From Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures comes Dune: Part Three, bringing Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Denis Villeneuve’s epic trilogy to a breathtaking conclusion.

Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As rebellion brews and enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

The film stars Oscar nominee Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Oscar nominee Florence Pugh, Rebecca Ferguson, Isaach de Bankolé, with Oscar nominee Charlotte Rampling, with Anya Taylor-Joy, and Robert Pattinson, and Oscar winner Javier Bardem.

Villeneuve directs from a screenplay by Villeneuve and Brian K. Vaughan, based on the novels written by Frank Herbert. The film is produced by Oscar nominees Mary Parent, Cale Boyter, Villeneuve and Tanya Lapointe, and Joe Caracciolo, and executive produced by Joshua Grode, Thomas Tull, Herbert W. Gains, Brian Herbert, Byron Merritt, Kim Herbert, Kevin J. Anderson, Richard P. Rubinstein, John Harrison and Jessica Derhammer.

Joining Villeneuve behind the camera are Oscar-winning director of photography Linus Sandgren, Oscar-winning production designer Patrice Vermette, Oscar-winning editor Joe Walker, Oscar nominated costume designer Jacqueline West, Oscar-nominated casting director Francine Maisler, and Oscar-winning composer Hans Zimmer.

Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures Present A Legendary Pictures Production, A Film By Denis Villeneuve, Dune: Part Three, only in theaters and IMAX® across North America on December 18, 2026 and internationally beginning 16 December 2026. The film will be distributed worldwide by Warner Bros. Pictures and in China by Legendary East.

snippet.title: MAIMATA | Chandan Shetty | Agastya Raag | Official Music Video
snippet.description:
MAIMATA | Official Music Video

Some heartbreaks leave scars. Some leave lessons. And some become the strength to move forward.

MAIMATA is a Kannada heartbreak rap that captures the emotions of love, loss, and finding the strength to rise again.

A musical expression inspired by emotions and experiences that many can relate to, brought to life through storytelling, music, and cinematic visuals.

This song is a work of creative storytelling, made purely for entertainment. Any resemblance to real-life individuals, relationships, or events is entirely coincidental.

Song: MAIMATA

Written | Composed | Performed | Directed by

snippet.title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend - New Trailer - Only In Cinemas November 5
snippet.description:
RAMAYANA: RISE OF A LEGEND - only in cinemas, IMAX and Premium Large Formats worldwide November 5. Tickets on Sale now.

Based on the celebrated ancient epic known to billions, Namit Malhotra's Ramayana: Rise of a Legend tells the story of Rama, a prince bound by sacrifice; Ravana, an immortal king driven by vengeance; and the prophecy that binds their fates together. It stars Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi. 

The film is produced by acclaimed filmmaker Namit Malhotra, whose Academy Award®-winning visual effects company DNEG has worked on films including The Odyssey, Dune, Interstellar, and Inception; directed by Nitesh Tiwari, whose film Dangal remains the highest-grossing Indian film worldwide; and scored by Academy Award® winners Hans Zimmer and A.R. Rahman. Namit Malhotra's Ramayana: Rise of a Legend will be released globally in cinemas in time for Diwali on November 5.

Follow us on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/sonypicturesuk
Find us on Instagram at http://www.instagram.com/sonypicturesuk 
Follow us on Twitter at https://twitter.com/sonypicturesuk 
Find us on TikTok at https://www.tiktok.com/@sonypictures.uk

Produced by: Namit Malhotra
Directed by: Nitesh Tiwari
Starring: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi
Music: Hans Zimmer and A.R. Rahman
Adaptation by: Shridhar Raghavan, Nitesh Tiwari
Editing by: Huzefa Lokhandwala
Production Design by: Ravi Bansal, Ramsey Avery
Action Design by: Guy Norris, Terry Notary
Costume Design by: Rimple & Harpreet Narula and Saniya Sardhariya
Visual Effects by: Dan Glass

In an age of gods and kings, the fate of worlds hangs in the balance. Rama, a prince bound by duty, sacrifice, and righteousness, must confront Ravana, an immortal ruler driven by pride and vengeance, powerful enough to shatter the cosmos.

চ্যানেল ডিসক্লেইমার – কমিকভার্স হলো একটি পপ কালচার কমেন্টারি ও ফিল্ম রিভিউ চ্যানেল, যা ফ্যান থিওরি, ফিল্ম, ওয়েব সিরিজ এবং ট্রেলার পর্যালোচনার জন্য উৎসর্গীকৃত। কমিকভার্স চ্যানেল মাঝে মাঝে ফিল্ম, ওয়েব সিরিজ, ট্রেলার এবং গান সম্পর্কে ব্যাখ্যা করার জন্য ফিল্ম ক্লিপ, টিভি সিরিজ ক্লিপ, ওয়েব সিরিজ ক্লিপ, অ্যানিমেশন সিরিজ ক্লিপ ব্যবহার করে থাকে, কিন্তু ১৯৭৬ সালের কপিরাইট আইনের ১০৭ ধারা অনুযায়ী সমালোচনা, মন্তব্য, সংবাদ প্রতিবেদন, শিক্ষাদান, বৃত্তি এবং গবেষণার মতো উদ্দেশ্যে ন্যায্য ব্যবহারের (FAIR USE) অনুমতি দেওয়া হয়।

snippet.description:
Kannukkulle Unnai Vaithen Song | Pennin Manathai Thottu (2000) | P. Unnikrishnan | S. A. Rajkumar

Song Description

Enjoy “Kannukkulle Unnai Vaithen” (கண்ணுக்குள்ளே உன்னை வைத்தேன்), a beautiful and soulful romantic melody from the Tamil film Pennin Manathai Thottu (2000), starring Prabhu Deva and Jaya Seal.

Featuring the melodious voice of P. Unnikrishnan, this song expresses deep love, affection, and the desire to keep a beloved person close to the heart forever. Its romantic imagery describes a love so precious that the singer wishes to cherish the beloved every moment, never letting distance or separation weaken their bond.

Composed by S. A. Rajkumar, the song blends a soothing melody with heartfelt vocals and memorable lyrics. The official music-video credits list Vaali and Vairamuthu as lyricists.

The Meaning and Emotion of the Song

The song conveys the feeling of being completely captivated by someone special. The beloved becomes a source of happiness, comfort, and emotional fulfilment. The lyrics use the image of keeping someone within one's eyes as a poetic expression of constant love and devotion.

P. Unnikrishnan's expressive singing gives the melody a gentle, intimate quality, making it suitable for romantic playlists, love-themed videos, and listeners who enjoy Tamil film melodies from the late 1990s and early 2000s.

Musical Highlights

Singer: P. Unnikrishnan's smooth, expressive vocals.
Composer: S. A. Rajkumar's memorable romantic melody.
Lyrics: Official video credits list Vaali and Vairamuthu.
Mood: Romantic, soothing, emotional, and nostalgic.
Film: A memorable musical selection from Pennin Manathai Thottu.

Watch the full video, celebrate the devotion of Maa Parvati, and share this beautiful bhakti song with your loved ones.

snippet.title: Jignesh Barot | રિહોમના | Rihomna | જિગ્નેશ બારોટ |  New Gujarati Song 2026
snippet.description:
🎶 @SaregamaGujarati રજૂ કરે છે "Rihomna", લોકપ્રિય ગુજરાતી ગાયક Jignesh Barot ના અવાજમાં એક સુંદર ગુજરાતી ઓડિયો ગીત.

Song Credits:

Song: Rihomna
Singer: Jignesh Barot
Producer: Red Velvet Cinema
Artists: Jignesh Barot, Viyona Patil, Avantika Bhatti, Dipika
Music Director: Jackie Gajjar
Lyricist: Naresh Thakor (Vayad)
Concept: Mayur Mehta, Purvi Vasava
Director: Mayur Mehta
DOP: Hardik Suthar
Creative Producer: Dhyey Films & Team
Technical Support: Jenish Talaviya
Makeup: Hasmukh Limbichiya
Jignesh Barot's Costume: Ekta J. Barot
Lights: Kalpesh Jadhav
Editor: Devang Patni
Production: Satish Thakor
Recording Studio: Sargam Music Studio, Patan (Pankaj Mistry)
Special Thanks: J. D. Bapu

Lyrics:

હો ચડ્યું ચડ્યું રાખે તારું મોઢું 
મને જોઈ તાકે સે તુ  દોઢું રે 
કઇદે ને શું રિહામણા લીધા

હો મને તારા વગર ઘડીકે ના ફાવે 
પણ તું મને ના બોલાવે 
કઇદે ને શું અબોલડા  લીધા
હો મનમાં શું ભરાયું ગોડી ભેદ આજે ખોલો
પેટ માં પડી વાતો તમે હોઠે લાવી બોલો

હો પેલા મળવા આવતી વાટો મારી જોતી
પડું થોડો લેટ ને તુ બેઠીબેઠી રોતી રે
કઈદે ને વેણ શુ કડવા કીધા 

હો કોણે ભર્યા કોન કઇદે કોણે કર્યા હલાડા
તારા મારા વચે આયા આજ જુદાઈ ના દાડા
હો તારો મારો રાગ જોઈને હઉ બળતા તા ચૌદશિયા
 એટલે તને પિન મારવા આયા હસે પંચાતિયા

હો બોલો મારી વાલી કોક બોલ્યે ખબર પડશે 
તમે નહીં બોલો તો આંખો આખી રાત રડશે

હો તારા મોઢે ચમ તે વાખી દીધા તાળા
બોલ શોગન સે તને મારા રે 
કઇદે ને શું રિહામણા લીધા

હો ભૂલ ચૂક જો થઈ હોય તો બોલીજા મારાથી
કોન પકડી માગી લઉ હાલ હમણાં તારી માફી
હો દીવો તું ભરે તો હું હાલ ઉપાડવા તૈયાર સુ
પ્રેમનું પરમોણ આપીશ ગોડી હાચો તારો પ્યાર સુ 

હો મારા જોડે રેનારી આજે મારાથી રિહાણી
મનાવું મોનીજા મારા દિલ ની મહા રાણી

એ આવું હારું ના લાગે ગોડી
સ્માઈલ મોઢે લાવો થોડી
કઇદે ને શું રિહામણા લીધા

localized.title: Jignesh Barot | રિહોમના | Rihomna | જિગ્નેશ બારોટ |  New Gujarati Song 2026
localized.description:
🎶 @SaregamaGujarati રજૂ કરે છે "Rihomna", લોકપ્રિય ગુજરાતી ગાયક Jignesh Barot ના અવાજમાં એક સુંદર ગુજરાતી ઓડિયો ગીત.

Song Credits:

Song: Rihomna
Singer: Jignesh Barot
Producer: Red Velvet Cinema
Artists: Jignesh Barot, Viyona Patil, Avantika Bhatti, Dipika
Music Director: Jackie Gajjar
Lyricist: Naresh Thakor (Vayad)
Concept: Mayur Mehta, Purvi Vasava
Director: Mayur Mehta
DOP: Hardik Suthar
Creative Producer: Dhyey Films & Team
Technical Support: Jenish Talaviya
Makeup: Hasmukh Limbichiya
Jignesh Barot's Costume: Ekta J. Barot
Lights: Kalpesh Jadhav
Editor: Devang Patni
Production: Satish Thakor
Recording Studio: Sargam Music Studio, Patan (Pankaj Mistry)
Special Thanks: J. D. Bapu

Lyrics:

હો ચડ્યું ચડ્યું રાખે તારું મોઢું 
મને જોઈ તાકે સે તુ  દોઢું રે 
કઇદે ને શું રિહામણા લીધા

હો મને તારા વગર ઘડીકે ના ફાવે 
પણ તું મને ના બોલાવે 
કઇદે ને શું અબોલડા  લીધા
હો મનમાં શું ભરાયું ગોડી ભેદ આજે ખોલો
પેટ માં પડી વાતો તમે હોઠે લાવી બોલો

હો પેલા મળવા આવતી વાટો મારી જોતી
પડું થોડો લેટ ને તુ બેઠીબેઠી રોતી રે
કઈદે ને વેણ શુ કડવા કીધા 

હો કોણે ભર્યા કોન કઇદે કોણે કર્યા હલાડા
તારા મારા વચે આયા આજ જુદાઈ ના દાડા
હો તારો મારો રાગ જોઈને હઉ બળતા તા ચૌદશિયા
 એટલે તને પિન મારવા આયા હસે પંચાતિયા

હો બોલો મારી વાલી કોક બોલ્યે ખબર પડશે 
તમે નહીં બોલો તો આંખો આખી રાત રડશે

હો તારા મોઢે ચમ તે વાખી દીધા તાળા
બોલ શોગન સે તને મારા રે 
કઇદે ને શું રિહામણા લીધા

હો ભૂલ ચૂક જો થઈ હોય તો બોલીજા મારાથી
કોન પકડી માગી લઉ હાલ હમણાં તારી માફી
હો દીવો તું ભરે તો હું હાલ ઉપાડવા તૈયાર સુ
પ્રેમનું પરમોણ આપીશ ગોડી હાચો તારો પ્યાર સુ 

હો મારા જોડે રેનારી આજે મારાથી રિહાણી
મનાવું મોનીજા મારા દિલ ની મહા રાણી

એ આવું હારું ના લાગે ગોડી
સ્માઈલ મોઢે લાવો થોડી
કઇદે ને શું રિહામણા લીધા

snippet.description:
ଭଜନ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ପାଇଁ ଯୋଗା ଯୋଗ - ଦୁଃଖୀଶ୍ୟାମ ତ୍ରିପାଠୀ - 9668833222

00:00 - ମଙ୍ଗଳାଚରଣ ଓ ବନ୍ଦନା
02:20 - ମହାଦେବ ଦାସଙ୍କ ସ୍ତୁତି ଓ କାର୍ତ୍ତିକ ବ୍ରତର ମହତ୍ତ୍ୱ
06:24 - ନୈମିଷାରଣ୍ୟରେ ମୁନିଗଣ ଓ ସୂତଙ୍କ କଥୋପକଥନ
07:32 - ସୂତ ଉବାଚ: କାର୍ତ୍ତିକ ମାହାତ୍ମ୍ୟ ଆରମ୍ଭ
10:23 - ସତ୍ୟଭାମା ଉବାଚ: ପ୍ରଭୁ ଶ୍ରୀକୃଷ୍ଣଙ୍କୁ ସତ୍ୟଭାମାଙ୍କ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ
13:37 - ଶ୍ରୀ ଭଗବାନ ଉବାଚ: ପାରିଜାତ ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗ ଓ କଳ୍ପଦ୍ରୁମ ବୃକ୍ଷ ତଳେ ଆଲୋଚନା
19:43 - ଦେବଶର୍ମା, ଚନ୍ଦ୍ରହାସ ଓ ଗୁଣବତୀଙ୍କ ଉପାଖ୍ୟାନ (ପ୍ରଥମ ଅଧ୍ୟାୟ ସମାପ୍ତ)
================================

snippet.title: छलड़े छलड़े बाल | Tu Sanwal Phul Kasturi | Krishna Bhajan | Chalrey Chalrey Wal Krishna Version Song
snippet.description:
छलड़े छलड़े बाल | Tu Sanwal Phul Kasturi | Krishna Bhajan Female Version | New Radha Krishna Bhajan

Song: छलड़े छलड़े बाल (Krishna Version)
Lyrics: Bunty Thakur
Music & Composer: Bunty Thakur
Singer: Kratika Thakur
Editing & Post Production : Chitrankan Recording Studio
Recording Studio: Chitrankan Recording Studio
Music Label: Bajao Music

🙏 राधे राधे 🙏
शरद पूर्णिमा 2026 के पावन अवसर पर Bajao Bhakti प्रस्तुत करता है "छलड़े छलड़े बाल" का कृष्ण संस्करण — सांवरे सलोने कान्हा को समर्पित एक मधुर Female Version ❤️तू सांवल फूल कस्तूरी" — यह पंक्ति जैसे साक्षात सांवरे सलोने श्याम के लिए ही लिखी गई हो। घुंघराले छलकते बाल, मोरपंख धारी मुकुट, कस्तूरी सा महकता रूप — वृंदावन के नटखट कान्हा की वही छवि इस भजन में उतर आई है। राधा रानी के प्रेम में डूबी यह मधुर धुन आपको सीधे ब्रज की गलियों में ले जाएगी, जहाँ हर साँस में बस एक ही नाम बसता है — कृष्ण।

This is the Krishna version of the trending folk melody, reimagined as a soulful Radha Krishna bhajan in a female voice. "Tu Sanwal Phul Kasturi" — the dark-complexioned one, fragrant as kasturi — is the most natural description of Sanwariya Seth himself. Perfect for Sharad Purnima and Raas Purnima, Kartik maas sadhana, Govardhan Puja, Vrindavan bhakti, morning meditation and quiet evening listening. 🦚

🌍 Radha Krishna devotees in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia and the Gulf — let this bhajan fill your home with Braj's devotion this Kartik month. 🪔

🦚 यह भजन खास तौर पर इनके लिए :
• शरद पूर्णिमा / रास पूर्णिमा की रात के लिए
• कार्तिक मास की साधना और दामोदर आराधना के लिए
• गोवर्धन पूजा और अन्नकूट के लिए
• सुबह-शाम की भक्ति, ध्यान और मन की शांति के लिए

Bajao Bhakti प्रस्तुत करता है रास पूर्णिमा (शरद पूर्णिमा) के पावन अवसर पर भगवान श्री कृष्ण और राधा रानी के दिव्य प्रेम को समर्पित एक अत्यंत ऊर्जावान और मधुर भजन — "छलड़े छलड़े बाल, तू सांवर फूल कस्तूरी"!

🌺 राधा कृष्ण भक्ति में डूब जाइए!

“तू सांवळ फूल कस्तूरी” के मधुर भावों के साथ श्री कृष्ण की मनमोहक छवि, राधा रानी के प्रेम और वृंदावन की दिव्य रासलीला का स्मरण करें। यह भक्तिमय गीत राधा-कृष्ण के भक्तों के लिए प्रेम, श्रद्धा और भक्ति से जुड़ने का एक सुंदर अवसर है।

✨ Radha Krishna Bhajan | Raas Purnima Special 2026

Whether you love Radha Krishna Bhajans, soulful Krishna devotional songs, or traditional bhakti geet, let this female version bring a devotional atmosphere to your home. Listen during daily puja, Krishna worship, bhajan gatherings, or moments of peaceful devotion.

🪷 यह भजन सुनें:
• Raas Purnima 2026 Special
• Radha Krishna Bhajan and Krishna Bhakti Geet
• Shri Krishna Bhajan for daily puja
• Radha Rani and Sanwariya devotional songs
• प्रेम, भक्ति और श्री कृष्ण के दिव्य स्मरण के लिए

Song: छलड़े छलड़े बाल (Krishna Version)
Lyrics: Bunty Thakur
Music & Composer: Bunty Thakur
Singer: Kratika Thakur
Editing & Post Production : Chitrankan Recording Studio
Recording Studio: Chitrankan Recording Studio
Music Label: Bajao Music

🙏 राधे राधे 🙏
शरद पूर्णिमा 2026 के पावन अवसर पर Bajao Bhakti प्रस्तुत करता है "छलड़े छलड़े बाल" का कृष्ण संस्करण — सांवरे सलोने कान्हा को समर्पित एक मधुर Female Version ❤️तू सांवल फूल कस्तूरी" — यह पंक्ति जैसे साक्षात सांवरे सलोने श्याम के लिए ही लिखी गई हो। घुंघराले छलकते बाल, मोरपंख धारी मुकुट, कस्तूरी सा महकता रूप — वृंदावन के नटखट कान्हा की वही छवि इस भजन में उतर आई है। राधा रानी के प्रेम में डूबी यह मधुर धुन आपको सीधे ब्रज की गलियों में ले जाएगी, जहाँ हर साँस में बस एक ही नाम बसता है — कृष्ण।

This is the Krishna version of the trending folk melody, reimagined as a soulful Radha Krishna bhajan in a female voice. "Tu Sanwal Phul Kasturi" — the dark-complexioned one, fragrant as kasturi — is the most natural description of Sanwariya Seth himself. Perfect for Sharad Purnima and Raas Purnima, Kartik maas sadhana, Govardhan Puja, Vrindavan bhakti, morning meditation and quiet evening listening. 🦚

🌍 Radha Krishna devotees in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia and the Gulf — let this bhajan fill your home with Braj's devotion this Kartik month. 🪔

🦚 यह भजन खास तौर पर इनके लिए :
• शरद पूर्णिमा / रास पूर्णिमा की रात के लिए
• कार्तिक मास की साधना और दामोदर आराधना के लिए
• गोवर्धन पूजा और अन्नकूट के लिए
• सुबह-शाम की भक्ति, ध्यान और मन की शांति के लिए

Bajao Bhakti प्रस्तुत करता है रास पूर्णिमा (शरद पूर्णिमा) के पावन अवसर पर भगवान श्री कृष्ण और राधा रानी के दिव्य प्रेम को समर्पित एक अत्यंत ऊर्जावान और मधुर भजन — "छलड़े छलड़े बाल, तू सांवर फूल कस्तूरी"!

🌺 राधा कृष्ण भक्ति में डूब जाइए!

“तू सांवळ फूल कस्तूरी” के मधुर भावों के साथ श्री कृष्ण की मनमोहक छवि, राधा रानी के प्रेम और वृंदावन की दिव्य रासलीला का स्मरण करें। यह भक्तिमय गीत राधा-कृष्ण के भक्तों के लिए प्रेम, श्रद्धा और भक्ति से जुड़ने का एक सुंदर अवसर है।

Whether you love Radha Krishna Bhajans, soulful Krishna devotional songs, or traditional bhakti geet, let this female version bring a devotional atmosphere to your home. Listen during daily puja, Krishna worship, bhajan gatherings, or moments of peaceful devotion.

- 16 teams — 2 days

SMASH Rule is the most exciting way to claim the trophy. Here's how it works this season:

Day 1 Overall Ranking #1 team's points +10 = Match Point Threshold
Hit the threshold on Day 2, then win another match to claim the title.

snippet.title: Weather News LIVE | অতি শক্তিশালী ঘূর্ণিঝড়ে পরিণত 'অর্ণব' | ওড়িশা, অন্ধ্রপ্রদেশে প্রবল বৃষ্টি
snippet.description:
ABP Ananda LIVE : ঘূর্ণিঝড় থেকে অতি শক্তিশালী ঘূর্ণিঝড়ে পরিণত 'অর্ণব'। ওড়িশা, অন্ধ্রপ্রদেশে প্রবল বৃষ্টিপুরী, খুরদা-সহ ওড়িশার বিভিন্ন জায়গায় ভারী বৃষ্টি। অন্ধ্রপ্রদেশের বিশাখাপত্তনম, মছলিপত্তনমেও দুর্যোগ। পশ্চিমবঙ্গে 'অর্ণব'-এর প্রভাবে বৃষ্টির পূর্বাভাস। ২৮-২৯ অক্টোবর: দক্ষিণবঙ্গের উপকূলীয় জেলাগুলিতে ভারী বৃষ্টির পূর্বাভাস। ২৭-২৯ অক্টোবর: পশ্চিমবঙ্গ উপকূলে ঘণ্টায় ৪০-৫০ কিমি ঝোড়ো হাওয়া। কাল সকালে অতি প্রবল ঘূর্ণিঝড় হিসেবে ল্যান্ডফলের সম্ভাবনা । অন্ধ্রপ্রদেশের বাপাটলা উপকূলের কাছে 'অর্ণব'-এর ল্যান্ডফলের সম্ভাবনা । ল্যান্ডফলের সময় সর্বোচ্চ গতিবেগ হতে পারে ঘণ্টায় ১৪০ কিমি। পশ্চিম-মধ্য বঙ্গোপসাগরে ঘূর্ণিঝড়টি ঘণ্টায় ২২ কিমি বেগে এগোচ্ছে পশ্চিম ও উত্তর-পশ্চিমের দিকে।
